system.title: 54 kWh Commercial Plus Backup Solution
system.summary: Commercial Plus two-stack backup configuration, depending on usage

summaryParagraphs: This proposal is structured for fixed-layout PDF delivery while still allowing selected customer, pricing, and project notes to be injected from QuickBooks or the internal Eos site.
Final equipment count, final pricing, and scope remain subject to site verification, utility constraints, permit review, and any approved change orders.
siteDetails: Existing service equipment and panel condition to be confirmed during pre-install inspection.
Generator coexistence, ATS strategy, and critical-load segmentation to be confirmed if legacy backup equipment is present.
If V2X is included, compatible EV model and charger configuration must be confirmed before final procurement.
standardInclusions: Delivery of listed hardware and standard wall-mounted installation.
Commissioning, safety testing, activation, and mobile app access.
Basic electrical material and wiring required for the listed configuration.
Permit coordination and utility-facing paperwork only if explicitly included in the sold scope.
exclusions: Main service upgrades, trenching, stucco or finish repair, and structural corrections.
Additional labor caused by concealed conditions, legacy wiring defects, or failed pre-existing equipment.
EV charger replacements or custom V2X integration work not listed in the proposal line items.
terms: Pricing in this template is illustrative and should be replaced by approved estimate values before sending.
Proposal validity, taxes, and financing are subject to lender, municipality, and project timing.
Eos may revise scope if the site survey or utility review reveals material changes from the assumed conditions.
narrative.acceptanceBody: Client approval authorizes Eos to finalize site verification, paperwork, and scheduling under the agreed scope and pricing version.

standardInstallationTerms: Integration with existing solar equipment into a unified system when applicable.
System commissioning, safety testing, and activation.
10-year manufacturer warranty on battery, controller, and inverter.
All work guaranteed to meet local electrical codes and standards.
Basic electrical materials and wiring are included.
Additional materials or unforeseen electrical work may create added charges.
v2xInstallationTerm: 3-year manufacturer warranty on the V2X module when included in scope.
